findings.evidence: skills/mcp.json:326-330 registers scrapling as `"command": "scrapling", "args": ["mcp"]` with no path/env qualification, implying it's a ready-to-run baked binary. `command -v scrapling` exits 1 in this container; `grep -rn scrapling flake.nix` and every *.nix file returns zero hits (no Python package, no pip-install step anywhere in the image build); scrapling/SKILL.md:53-65 itself says the user must run `pip install "scrapling[all]>=0.4.3"` and `scrapling install --force` before it works. cluster_recommendation: The browser cluster (browser, browser-automation, chrome-cdp, playwright, qe-browser) is functionally well-differentiated by capability tier (AI-snapshot automation / routing meta-skill / raw CDP / heavyweight 40+-tool automation / QE-typed-assertions) and SKILL-DIRECTORY.md's own audit note ("4 active + 1 meta... no merge needed") is right on structure — but wrong on freshness: it doesn't catch that the group shares one bad fact. browser/SKILL.md should stay canonical for the sidecar connection block (it's the right ownership model, correctly deferred-to by browser-automation, chrome-cdp and playwright), but its CDP port (9222) is wrong and has propagated verbatim into browser-automation/references/sidecar.md and independently duplicated in chrome-cdp/references/reference.md — fix the one canonical block and cascade the correction, using playwright/SKILL.md's already-correct two-port table (9223 in-network / 9222 host-mapped) as the reference. No merges or redirects needed in this sub-cluster; it's a single stale-fact propagation bug, not a structural duplication problem. Separately, web-summary and gemini-url-context are wrongly cross-contradictory (web-summary's own reference doc calls gemini-url-context dead when it's the healthiest skill in the batch) and both carry SKILL-DIRECTORY.md MCP-table rot pointing at non-existent/legacy server files — these two plus playwright's phantom mcp-server/server.js row mean the SKILL-DIRECTORY.md "MCP Server Summary" table is unreliable for at least 3/11 skills in this batch and should be regenerated from mcp.json + each skill's own frontmatter rather than hand-maintained. scrapling and youtube-transcript-archiver are the two "silently not really there" cases: scrapling registers an MCP command with no baked binary and no install-status caveat (unlike qe-browser, which is honest about NOT INSTALLED), and youtube-transcript-archiver is functionally sound (its yt-transcript-archive binary genuinely exists) but is invisible to discovery and untested against the Codex/GPT-6 Astra half of the estate.
